The count is not the defect — the defect is that the system observed the same fact 74 times and changed nothing: it did not stop selecting the activity, did not open a gap against the cause, and did not try a different route. The class is recorded, so the typed-delta path applies; the open question is why the repetition itself never became a disposition.
